answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before it can bid on jobs, whether surveying a terrace, monitoring a sparrow, or locating nectar sources. Each identity gets the same daily bid limit, so splitting into 1,000 identities requires locking $100,000 to gain 1,000 shares of bidding capacity. The defense makes influence depend on committed capital, imposing a financing and opportunity cost on the attacker.
